<description>
**Problem:** An interrupted snapshot cleanup can leave a nonempty `chainstate_todelete` database.
On the next cleanup attempt, renaming the background database to that occupied path fails and prevents startup from completing.

**Fix:** Remove the obsolete database before resetting the live chainstates and renaming the directories.
If removal fails, retain the live chainstates and report an error.
</description>

<commits>
98c89a0b27 test: characterize interrupted snapshot cleanup

Record the startup failure caused by an obsolete background database left at the temporary deletion path.

c40de00e71 validation: remove leftover snapshot cleanup data

Remove an obsolete background database before reusing the deletion path.
Keep the live chainstates intact if removal fails.
</commits>
